verdict.rationale: Headless automation is only possible on narrow side channels. The Comptroller publishes machine-readable raw datasets, and a keyless probe confirmed its franchise-permit-holder dataset returns structured JSON over a SODA query, so read-only status lookups can be scripted in CI. EDI is mentioned as a bulk filing channel for large businesses, but the core filing and payment surface (Webfile) sits behind an authenticated eSystems browser session, and no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt exists. Missing for 10: a documented API for filing and payment, service or token authentication for unattended runs, EDI technical documentation, a CLI or SDK, and hands-on evidence of any write-side automation.
